title: Qomhrá: A Bilingual Irish and English Large Language Model

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing closed-weight LLMs' automated preference rankings of translation quality against L1 and L2 human speaker annotations using a Bradley-Terry model to detect algorithmic preferences for specific (e.g., GPT-style) model-generated outputs.

Benchmarking and comparing model performance disparities between a high-resource language (English) and an extreme low-resource language (Irish) across parallel tasks such as multiple-choice question answering (IQA-gle/IQA-eng) and translation (BLEU).
